With only $45 cash and houses on Park Place and Boardwalk, Vermont isn't doing much for me since I lack Oriental and Connecticut. Selling Vermont to p3 for $140 would give them two of three light blues, though Connecticut's still locked up with p1 who won't deal—moderate risk, but that cash could fund more houses on my dark blues at $200 each.

Actually Illinois is more interesting since I already hold Kentucky and Indiana, so getting Illinois would complete my red monopoly outright. I'll counter at $190, which combined with my current cash gets me right up to the $200 needed for another house.
